:::{#def-oinf}
#### Observed information matrix

The **observed information matrix**, written $\oinf$,
is the negative of the [Hessian](#def-hessian) of the log-likelihood,
evaluated at the observed data.
It is the sample counterpart of the
[expected information](#def-einf),
which averages the same quantity over possible data sets:

{{< include sds/_subfiles/intro-MLEs/_eq_def_oinf.qmd >}}

:::
